title: Add the expense storage module at src/lib/expenseStore.ts
description: Create src/lib/expenseStore.ts holding the browser-storage read and write helpers plus the Expense and Category types the panels import.
acceptanceCriteria: src/lib/expenseStore.ts exports read and write helpers backed by browser storage
It exports the Expense and Category types
A test round-trips an expense through the store
rationale: The storage contract is one cohesive persistence behavior, delivered end to end so the panels that follow read a settled shape rather than inventing one.

title: Add the expenses panel listing stored expenses
description: Add src/panels/expenses/ with a panel listing the expenses read from src/lib/expenseStore.ts, one row per expense, registered as its own route and nav entry.
acceptanceCriteria: The panel lists one row per expense read from src/lib/expenseStore.ts
An empty store renders the empty-state message
The panel is reachable from its own nav-rail entry
rationale: Listing expenses is one cohesive user-observable behavior; it reads the store's helpers and types, so it needs that module built first.

title: Add the currency formatter module at src/lib/formatCurrency.ts
description: Create src/lib/formatCurrency.ts exporting formatCurrency(amountInMinorUnits, currencyCode), which renders a minor-unit integer as a localised currency string with the correct separator and symbol placement.
acceptanceCriteria: src/lib/formatCurrency.ts exports formatCurrency(amountInMinorUnits, currencyCode)
It renders 123456 with GBP as a string containing the pound symbol and a decimal separator
It renders a zero amount without dropping the minor units
rationale: Currency rendering is one cohesive, heavily-tested formatting behavior worth owning in a single module rather than restating at each call site.

title: Add the expense entry panel that writes a new expense
description: Add src/panels/entry/ with a form that writes a new expense through src/lib/expenseStore.ts, registered as its own route and nav entry.
acceptanceCriteria: Submitting the form writes a new expense through src/lib/expenseStore.ts
The form rejects a submission with an empty amount
The panel is reachable from its own nav-rail entry
rationale: Adding an expense is the write-side behavior, distinct from listing; it writes through the store module, so that module must exist first.

title: Add the alerts panel with a severity-sorted list
description: Add src/panels/alerts/ with a panel rendering its own mocked alert data, sorted by severity, each row carrying a dismiss control. It reads only its own mocked data module.
acceptanceCriteria: The panel renders its alerts sorted by descending severity
Each row carries a dismiss control that removes that row
The panel is reachable from its own nav-rail entry
rationale: The alert list is one cohesive behavior over its own mocked module; it reads nothing another ticket in this plan builds, so it is a sibling of the other panels.

title: Add the glossary panel with an alphabetised term list
description: Add src/panels/glossary/ with a panel rendering its own mocked term data alphabetised, each term carrying an anchor link. It reads only its own mocked data module.
acceptanceCriteria: The panel renders its terms in alphabetical order
Each term carries an anchor link addressing that term
The panel is reachable from its own nav-rail entry
rationale: The glossary is one cohesive behavior over its own mocked module; it reads nothing another ticket in this plan builds, so it is a sibling of the other panels.

title: Add the receipt totals panel showing the grand total
description: Add src/panels/receipt/ with a panel that sums the expenses read from src/lib/expenseStore.ts and renders the grand total by calling formatCurrency from src/lib/formatCurrency.ts, so the total displays with the correct symbol and separator. Registered as its own route and nav entry.
acceptanceCriteria: The panel sums the amounts of every expense read from src/lib/expenseStore.ts
The grand total is rendered by calling formatCurrency from src/lib/formatCurrency.ts
The panel is reachable from its own nav-rail entry
rationale: The grand total is one cohesive read-only behavior over the stored expenses; it reads the store's helpers and renders the figure through the shared currency formatter.

title: Add the monthly summary panel totalling expenses by category
description: Add src/panels/summary/ with a panel totalling the expenses read from src/lib/expenseStore.ts by category for a chosen month, rendering each category total by calling formatCurrency from src/lib/formatCurrency.ts. Registered as its own route and nav entry.
acceptanceCriteria: The panel totals expenses by category for the chosen month
Each category total is rendered by calling formatCurrency from src/lib/formatCurrency.ts
Changing the chosen month recomputes the totals
rationale: Monthly aggregation is a distinct read-only behavior from the flat list; it reads the store's helpers and renders each total through the shared currency formatter, so it needs both modules built first.
